results.reason: Identifies that the window expired and that under §5.7(c) the Ferrovane non-renewal is deemed cured for Article IX and §7.2(a). States that Harrowgate lost its walk right and indemnity. Notes the window is shown by the Oct 13 letter.

Explains that Escrow §1.1 is limited to actual out-of-pocket losses and excludes diminution in value, lost profits and attorneys' fees. Explains that SPA §11.11 lets the Escrow Agreement control disbursement mechanics, so the narrow definition limits escrow recovery.

Identifies MSA §14.2's >50% trigger, that the 100% sale triggers it, and that the consent is absent from Annex 7.2(d), the §7.2(d) condition and the §4.4 rep. Notes the sole-source supplier risk of termination or repricing after a compelled close.
States the window closed Monday, September 28, 2026, 10 Business Days after September 14, before the October 13 letter.
Memorandum addressed to the Supervising Partner. Each issue has 'Where it appears', 'Why it matters' and 'Recommended fix' sections.
Section 6 sets out open points unresolved from the documents and needing client input, with sources identified.
Expressly states Harrowgate no longer has a termination right for Ferrovane. The live window it discusses is only for the Second Supplement.
States Annex 7.2(d) lists only the payoff letter and lien release, so Tavinor's consent is not a closing condition.
